articles.title: Gabe Jacas makes his Patriots debut and other takeaways from Day 7 of training camp
articles.description:
After a stellar showing from New England's offense on Friday, the Patriots' defense recorded two interceptions on Saturday.

The post Gabe Jacas makes his Patriots debut and other takeaways from Day 7 of training camp appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Gabe Jacas debuted with the Patriots during Day 7 of training camp on August 1.
Patriots' defense intercepted two passes, showcasing improved performance after Friday's offensive success.
Local fans can expect heightened competition as the team prepares for the upcoming season.
